title: task.steer input
description: Redirect a delegated worker, raise one declared lane-budget dimension, or re-accept its plan. A raise changes its cap without steering. The caller must be its parent or ancestor, escalation target, or an active delegated sibling with the same parent and project.

limits.description: Typed raise of one declared lane-budget dimension. Names the dimension and the new absolute cap. A value equal to the current cap is refused as the exact limit.

reaccept.description: Hand your own accepted plan down to the worker again when its plan acceptance was voided (it says it needs an accepted plan). Only the delegating session may.
